site.name: FIREcalc
site.description: Public free retirement and financial-independence calculator. No account, no payment, and no public compute API. A local MCP program can run on the user's own computer; it is documented at https://firecalc.ai/ai and it is not served from this site. A separate link-only MCP is a draft for connector tests (not in the ChatGPT directory) and only builds share URLs. The site does no server-side calculation. Read https://firecalc.ai/llms.txt for what the tool does and how the model works.
